what_happened: In job d0k9, the user corrected Athena's first reading before work began. The job is a retry of the design-review cadence request, which queues a design review every 10 landed jobs. The reading did not carry over two things from the earlier attempt. First, that attempt's change was sound and should be kept. It failed only because a nested-run test hit the disk guard on low real disk, and commit 3947eb3 already fixed that by having tests set the minimum to 0. Second, no design-review role exists yet, so the request the cadence queues must carry its whole content. It must say what to review: the code-health table, the files most changed and most broken since the last review, open structural-pass requests, and recent rejections and planning stops. It must say what to produce: a short design note with proposed changes, run as a design-only job.
cause: A retry's reading is built from the request text alone. Athena keeps no record of what the failed attempt achieved, why it failed (a disk-guard test failure, not a design flaw), or what a later commit already fixed. It also does not check which roles exist in the current snapshot. Nothing compares the new reading with the prior attempt's verdict, the landed fix 3947eb3 or the repo's roles before the reading is accepted. The user is therefore the only carrier of the keep-the-design decision and of the fact that the queued request must be self-contained. The same two corrections have already been made on sibling jobs of this family.
prevention: When a request is a retry or follow-up of an earlier job, the reading stage gets a carry-over record taken from that job: its design, the verdict or failure reason, the fixes landed since, and the changes it was allowed to make. The reading must state each item as kept or changed. The same stage checks every role or capability the reading relies on against the current snapshot. If one is absent, as the design-review role is, the reading must make the queued request carry the full content itself. A reading that omits either check is not accepted.
proposed_request: Retry the design-review cadence job (earlier attempt failed only because a nested-run test hit the disk guard on low real disk; commit 3947eb3 fixed that by having tests set the minimum to 0). Keep the earlier attempt's design and change; do not redesign it. No design-review role exists yet, so the request the cadence queues every 10 landed jobs must carry its whole content. It must say what to review: the code-health table, the files most changed and most broken since the last review, open structural-pass requests, and recent rejections and planning stops. It must say what to produce: a short design note with proposed changes, run as a design-only job. Acceptance: the cadence queues this self-contained request after every 10 landed jobs, and a test shows the queued request text contains each review item and the design-only output; nested-run tests set the disk minimum to 0 and pass on a low-disk machine; the full test suite passes.
